text:
marta: heads-up — autopay batch processed this morning and ~18 payments declined (~$74.3k). majority show CVV/exp date failures or expired cards. marking as potential churn risk cohort, pls advise retry + outreach plan.

billing-bot: autopay-batch summary 2026-03-10T02:14Z: total_attempts=432, declines=18, decline_total=74300, top_accounts=[NovaHealth:$25000, Lumina:$12000, Curamap:$8000], decline_reasons=[expired_card:12, insufficient_funds:3, blocked:3].

aj: I'll run two immediate retries: t+0 and t+60m with card-network retry flags. After second fail we'll queue dunning email. For >$10k accounts we'll pause autopay and request manual payment instructions unless sales says otherwise.

nora: @aj please hold on pausing NovaHealth — they're in our onboarding ramp and @trevor is handling. For mid-contract strategic accounts we should prefer direct contact first.

trevor: calling NovaHealth now. If they can't update card quickly, propose wire for March invoice. Finance, do we have a wire-instructions template I can send?

marta: yes, I'll draft the wire template and put it in the shared drive. Also drafting an ACH micro-deposit checklist for customers that can switch to ACH instead of re-entering a card.

sam: support has 3 tickets referencing the decline message 'card expired' — copying the customer-facing copy we'll send below.

sam: "Hi {name}, we attempted to charge the card on file and it was declined due to an expired card. You can update your payment method here: https://app.redwood.ai/billing/update-payment or reply to this thread and we'll help. If you'd prefer, we can take a one-time wire or set up ACH. — Redwood Billing"

aj: sending the retry command now: 
```\n# retry job for failed autopays\nPOST /internal/billing/retry\n{"batch_id": "2026-03-10-autopay", "strategy": "two_immediate", "notify_on_fail": true}\n```

aj: note: card network returns truncated AVS/CVV errors for expired cards; retries usually fail if card actually expired. Plan B = update link + outreach.

marta: for the large ones (NovaHealth, Lumina, Curamap) I'll create a 'manual-pay' folder with wire instructions + invoice PDF. @trevor @nora please confirm contact outcomes so we don't auto-cancel services.

billing-bot: scheduled emails: dunning_1 (24h), dunning_2 (72h), escalate_to_sales_for_top_accounts=true.

nora: thanks — I'll coordinate with sales and customer success. If NovaHealth agrees to wire, we'll need them to fill the wire form and attach proof of payment.

trevor: update: on call, NovaHealth PM will update card within 2 hours. I'll follow up in this thread.

marta: TL;DR action list: 1) aj run retries (in progress), 2) billing-bot queue dunning emails, 3) trevor contact top accounts (in progress), 4) marta publishes wire template + ACH checklist (in progress), 5) nora monitors for churn signals. I'll reconvene after retries complete. :thumbsup:
